Material and style for every element: polished brass astrolabe rings and engraved star-chart filigree over midnight-blue enamel, tiny inset star gems, observatory instrument design. Crisp polished game-UI asset rendering, front view, evenly lit, consistent style across all four elements. The center panels are smooth and plain.
